tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Find Register cases by keywords (company, system, failure, e.g. 'coding agent deletes database', 'robotaxi', 'prompt injection email'), optionally filtered by world (physical, bridge, software, transaction, boundary) or by a control ID that was missing or failed. Returns short summaries with URLs.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: The full case: every claim with its type (fact, assertion, interpretation) and source links, the outcome, controls that failed, were absent or held, the Register's labeled interpretation, right-of-reply status for each named party, corrections, and a ready citation.

tools.name: list_controls
tools.description: The Register's controls (the safeguards that would interrupt the failures it records), each with how many published cases record it as failed, absent or held.

tools.name: get_control
tools.description: One control: its definition, the cases where it failed, was absent or held, and the regulations and standards that require, imply or recommend it.

tools.name: find_rules
tools.description: Regulations and standards that bear on autonomous systems, filtered by keyword, jurisdiction (e.g. 'European Union', 'United States', 'California'), or control ID. Each lists the controls it maps to and how strongly (required, implied, recommended, proposed).

tools.name: recent_signals
tools.description: The Register's nightly stream of new primary records (vulnerability entries, recalls, rules) touching systems that act on their own, newest first. Signals never assign fault.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cases · Private data: search_cases, list_controls, recent_signals · Public sink: search_cases.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_cases · Private data: search_cases, list_controls, recent_signals · Public sink: search_cases

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
